## Summary

The May 8 and November 7, 2026 captures describe Link autofill on Stripe's hosted invoice page. Stripe provides a private URL where the recipient can view, pay and download an invoice. Enabling Link on this hosted page requires no extra implementation code. The guides document compatibility with the Invoices and Subscriptions APIs.

## Enable Link on the Hosted Invoice Page

1. Open the [Invoice template](https://dashboard.stripe.com/settings/billing/invoice) in Dashboard.
2. Under **Payment methods**, choose **Manage**.
3. Toggle Link on and choose **Save**.

Both captures say “all of your customers” can pay faster after enabling Link. The separate November Invoicing payment methods table lists Link in most currencies and business locations. The Link integration guide limits display to eligible transactions. Funding eligibility can further depend on the business, presentment currency, amount, customer location and recurring or off-session support. See [[source-stripe-link-payment-integrations]] and [[source-stripe-link-payment-methods]].

## Invoice-Specific Payment Methods

- **Hosted page and Dashboard.** Account defaults apply to newly created invoices. A merchant can choose methods for an individual invoice in Dashboard. The November hosted invoice guide says the customer can still use an existing default payment method on the hosted page when it is absent from that invoice's configuration.
- **Invoicing API.** The separate November payment methods guide says that if you override payment methods through the API, include the configured default method type in `payment_method_types` when a default exists on the customer-configured Account, Customer or associated Subscription. The guide says payment fails if the override excludes that default.

The hosted enablement and API compatibility describe these integration surfaces. They leave API version, PaymentMethod representation, automatic renewal and outcomes to separate evidence.

## Hosted URL and Invoice Status

The November Invoice object reference says `Invoice.hosted_invoice_url` is null before finalization. The November hosted invoice guide says an issued URL expires 30 days after the due date or, without a due date, 30 days after finalization. The expiration window is at most 120 days. The guide separately guarantees at least 10 days of validity for URLs displayed in Dashboard or retrieved through the API, including after expiration.

The Invoice object has a separate `status` field with `draft`, `open`, `paid`, `uncollectible` and `void`. A reachable hosted URL, Link display, autofill or a payment attempt leaves paid status and settlement to their own evidence. See the hosted invoice and Invoice object references below.

payments-link-invoicing.text: Link is compatible with both the [Invoices](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices.md) and [Subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions.md) APIs.
Your customers can pay invoices faster using Link as a payment method to autofill their payment details.
The hosted invoice page provides a secure, private URL where your customers can view, pay, and download copies of the invoice.
Find Link, toggle it on, and click **Save**.
After you enable Link in the hosted invoice page, all of your customers can pay their invoices faster using Link.
Link is compatible with both the [Invoices](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices.md) and [Subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions.md) APIs.
Find Link, toggle it on, and click **Save**.

payments-link-invoicing.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/invoicing, the November capture describes Stripe’s hosted invoice page with Link autofill. Stripe supplies a unique private invoice URL that customers can use to view, pay and download the invoice. Enable Link in Dashboard under Invoice template → Payment methods → Manage, toggle Link on, and save. This hosted setup requires no extra implementation code and is compatible with the Invoices and Subscriptions APIs (new raw lines 7-25 and old raw lines 6-24). The May capture documents the same behavior, and `source-stripe-invoicing-link.md` lines 13–20 records the steps, API compatibility and page behavior. Its ‘zero implementation changes’ shorthand needs the hosted scope. The separately linked integration guide limits display to eligible transactions, the Invoicing payment methods table lists Link for most currencies and locations and supports invoice-specific configuration, and the Invoice object documents that the hosted URL is null before finalization. An accessible URL, Link display or autofill is distinct from a paid invoice or successful settlement.
payments-link-invoicing.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/invoicing, November changes casing, captions, screenshot reference, whitespace and list numbering. The setup, UI workflow, API compatibility and product wording are unchanged (old raw lines 6-24 and new raw lines 7-25). Preserve the May screenshot provenance and both captures’ ‘all of your customers’ phrasing as dated in `source-stripe-invoicing-link.md`. Qualify it on the source and reciprocal Link concept Invoicing route. The Invoicing payment methods guide lists Link for ‘Most currencies’ and ‘Most locations’; the Link integration guide scopes display to eligible transactions. The hosted invoice guide applies account defaults to newly created invoices and allows per-invoice Dashboard selections. An existing customer default can still be used on the hosted page when omitted from the invoice’s configuration (hosted guide lines 64-70). Separately, when overriding invoice payment methods via the Invoicing API, include the configured default from the customer-configured Account, Customer or associated Subscription in `payment_method_types`, or payment fails (payment methods guide lines 74-80). Route both scopes without generalizing them across flows. Scope the Dashboard toggle and no-extra-code wording to Stripe’s hosted invoice page on the source, Link concept, Stripe index, and Stripe company route. API compatibility establishes no version or PaymentMethod representation change, automatic renewal, or successful charge. `Invoice.hosted_invoice_url` is null until finalization. Issued URLs expire 30 days after the due date or, if none, 30 days after finalization, with a maximum expiration window of 120 days. URLs displayed in the Dashboard or retrieved via API are guaranteed valid for at least 10 days, including after expiration. Issuance and reachability are distinct from the separate Invoice status field and a paid outcome (hosted guide lines 20-36 and Invoice object lines 269-273 and 341-348).

concept_suggestions.proposed_markdown:
Enabling Link on Stripe's hosted invoice page requires no extra implementation code. In Dashboard, open **Invoice template**, choose **Manage** under **Payment methods**, toggle Link on and save. The May and November 2026 guides document compatibility with the Invoices and Subscriptions APIs and a private URL for viewing, paying and downloading the invoice. Their broad “all of your customers” wording is subject to eligible transactions. The November Invoicing table lists most currencies and locations.

Account defaults apply to newly created invoices and Dashboard can select methods per invoice. In the hosted flow, an existing customer default can still be used when absent from the invoice configuration. In the separately documented API override, include the configured default method type in `payment_method_types` when the customer-configured Account, Customer or associated Subscription has one, or payment fails.

`Invoice.hosted_invoice_url` is null before finalization. The November hosted invoice guide describes expiry 30 days after the due date or, if absent, 30 days after finalization, with a maximum 120-day window. It separately guarantees at least 10 days for links shown in Dashboard or retrieved via API, including after expiration. URL reachability, Link display and autofill leave paid status and settlement to separate evidence. See [[source-stripe-invoicing-link]] for the dated hosted page, payment methods and Invoice object references.
